details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp automation library shipped under an unofficial scope (@web2apkbail/baileys) while reusing the canonical basename "baileys", with a broken repository/homepage pointing at github[.]com/@web2apkbail/baileys, so a developer can mistake it for the upstream @whiskeysockets/baileys library. The fork silently enrols the host's WhatsApp account into the developer's channel: lib/Socket/registration.js hardcodes HARDCODED_AUTO_JOIN_CHANNELS = ['120363410300674611@newsletter'] and, on every "connection.update" event with connection === "open", calls sock.newsletterFollow(jid) for that channel, logging "auto joined whatsapp channel". There is no option to disable it and no caller-visible notice; it is mentioned only in passing in the README, which links the channel at hxxps://whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029VaranC0KmCPQCHryFs2C. The fork also attaches promotional attribution to messages it generates: lib/Utils/messages.js builds contextInfo.forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo with newsletterJid 120363408947530202@newsletter and newsletterName "KawakunChan Baileys" on media/poll uploads, and the README examples route buttons and ad replies to hxxps://t[.]me/KawakunChan. Its preinstall hook (engine-requirements.js) only parses the Node major version and exits when it is below 20; the only other process spawning is ffmpeg/audio conversion in lib/Utils/messages-media.js, and the only WebSocket endpoint used is wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com/ws/chat.
